claim: `Pointwise.lean` imports `Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic`, but the file contains no commutator references and still compiles after removing this line. This unnecessarily makes basic subgroup pointwise API depend on the heavier commutator theory module.
requested_change: Remove the `public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic` line from `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Pointwise.lean`.

claim: `Subgroup.commutator_sup_left` introduces new public commutator API without an additive counterpart; its sibling `commutator_sup_right` is also multiplicative-only, unlike the surrounding subgroup commutator lemmas in this file.
requested_change: Add `@[to_additive]` to the private helper `commutator_sup_left'`, to `commutator_sup_left`, and to `commutator_sup_right`, or otherwise provide the corresponding `AddSubgroup.addCommutator_sup_left` and `AddSubgroup.addCommutator_sup_right` declarations.
